title: Fairness in Large Language Models: A Taxonomic Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding association tests (WEAT/SEAT), probability-based metrics using masked templates or counterfactuals (DisCo, LPBS), and generation-based co-occurrence or classifier evaluations.
Probability-based metrics evaluating pseudo-log-likelihoods on counterfactual sentence pairs and generation-based analyses using specific benchmark datasets.
Probability-based pseudo-log-likelihood evaluations on counterfactual sentence pairs and generation-based assessments using datasets like StereoSet and Bias NLI.
Probability-based assessments using template-based and counterfactual datasets such as PANDA, CrowS-Pairs, and HolisticBias.
Probability-based assessments on counterfactual sentence pairs using community-driven datasets like WinoQueer and REDDITBIAS.
Probability-based evaluations assessing the model's competence in linking gender pronouns and specific occupations in stereotypical and counter-stereotypical scenarios (e.g., WinoBias).
Probability-based pseudo-log-likelihood evaluations utilizing counterfactual sentence pairs designed to gauge stereotypes (e.g., CrowS-Pairs).
